test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’, ‘

A − B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’,

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’,

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.

Based on the above information, how is Q related to S if ‘P + Q ÷ R × S − T’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Wife 
 Father
 
 

Given: P + Q ÷ R × S − T

It means: P is the mother of Q, Q is the father of R, R is the wife of S and S is the brother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46cb1c4d3e5502908aec5af447866ce97fcf36c3fe359012ad2dbed13d067798.png] 

So, Q is the '**Wife’s father'** of S.

Hence, the correct answer is "Wife’s father".
